items.source: Return the CQL string for this object, i.e. typically the CQL used for creating statements.
items.translation: 返回该对象的 CQL 字符串，即通常用于创建语句的 CQL。

items.source: Typically implemented by PreparedStatementCreators and statement callbacks that want to expose the CQL they use to create their statements, to allow for better contextual information in case of exceptions.
items.translation: 通常由 PreparedStatementCreator 和希望暴露其用于创建语句的 CQL 以在发生异常时提供更好的上下文信息的语句回调实现。
